title: FIFA Club World Cup 2025: Juventus Rout Al-Ain As Kolo Muani, Conceicao Shine
text:
FIFA Club World Cup 2025: Juventus Rout Al-Ain As Kolo Muani, Conceicao Shine
Randal Kolo Muani and Chico Conceicao netted a brace each, while Kenan Yildiz added the other in the Serie A heavyweights' triumph over the side from the United Arab Emirates.
Italian giants Juventus got their FIFA Club World Cup 2025 campaign off to a bright start as they smashed UAE’s Al-Ain in their opening Group G game at the Audi Field in Washington, USA on Thursday.
Randal Kolo Muani and Chico Conceicao netted a brace each, while Kenan Yildiz added the other in the Serie A heavyweights’ triumph over the side from the United Arab Emirates.
Recommended Stories
Juventus sent a delegation to the White House to visit USA President Donald Trump and presented the American with a jersey, a day prior to their opener.
Juve boss Igor Tudor said, “You don’t go to the White House every day, so it was a real pleasure to go there."
“In the game we did a number of excellent things, we played at a good tempo," the 47-year-old said.
“All things considered it’s a good start," the Croat added.
ALSO READ| FIFA Club World Cup 2025: Real Madrid Held By Al Hilal, Man City Down Wydad, Salzburg Beat Pachua
Earlier in the day, Spanish heavyweights Real Madrid were held to a draw by Saudi Pro League outfit Al Hilal as Xabi Alonso’s reign at the helm of the Spanish Capital City giants was off to a testing start.
Gonzalo Garcia opened the scoring on the day before Ruben Neves’ strike from the spot brought the Saudi unit back on level terms as the sides ended up sharing the spoils.
Manchester City registered a 2-0 win over Wydad Casablanca as Phil Foden scored one and assited Jeremy Doku for the other as Pep Guardiola’s men opened the event with a win over the Moroccan side.
ALSO READ| Berlin Open: Aryna Sabalenka’s Clash Against Rebeka Masarova Suspended Midway
RB Salzburg pipped Pachua 2-1 thanks to goals from Oscar Gloukh and Karim Onisiwo on either side of a Bryan Gonzalez strike for the Mexican side as the Austrian team picked up all points on offer in their first outing in the revamped edition of the tournament.
